content: Samar Ghosh inquired about the delay in receiving the confirmation email for their life insurance policy. Anita Sharma confirmed the policy is still in the activation process and informed Samar that the confirmation email with details would arrive by the end of the day. Samar asked for confirmation that the policy would be active by today and inquired about a follow-up call; Anita confirmed the policy activation and stated that no call would be made, but invited Samar to reach out directly with any questions.

action_items: Customer to expect confirmation email with policy details by end of day
Customer to contact agent directly if they have further questions
